skill.summary: Fast local PDF parsing with PyMuPDF (fitz) for Markdown/JSON outputs and optional images/tables. Use when speed matters more than robustness, or as a fallbac...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of a fast, local PDF parser using PyMuPDF (fitz) for Markdown and optional JSON outputs.
- Supports per-document output directories, image extraction, and rough table extraction.
- Includes command-line options for output format, images, tables, output directory, and language hints.
- Enforces strict security guardrails: parsed content stays local, source files remain untouched, and user confirmation required for batch processing.
